item_short_desc: Embrace the classic railroad engineer style with Rothco's Hickory Stripe Engineer Cap. This iconic hat is constructed with a well-structured, sturdy, and heavyweight 100% cotton material, ensuring durability and shape retention. The crown of the cap features a single piece of cotton fabric, loosely folded and pleated to the hatband, giving it the recognizable vintage look and feel. Designed with the traditional blue and white, heavy hickory striped print, this engineer cap captures the essence of historical conductors.
